name: Aquaguard Select Classic+
summary: Aquaguard Select Classic+ is a stylish wall-mounted UV water purifier featuring Active Copper, Zinc Booster, Biotron and UV E-Boiling technologies .
intro: Aquaguard Select Classic+ is a premium UV water purifier featuring Active Copper, Zinc Booster, Biotron and UV E-Boiling technologies. It provides multi-stage purification while retaining essential minerals, with a compact wall-mounted design ideal for modern kitchens.
features: Patented Active Copper Technology – Adds the benefits of copper and zinc to drinking water.
UV E-Boiling Technology – Delivers water as safe and pure as water boiled for over 20 minutes.
Multi-Stage Purification – Effectively removes bacteria, viruses and impurities.
Mineral Guard Technology – Helps retain essential minerals such as calcium and magnesium.
Health Protect Technology – Supports genuine cartridge usage with timely replacement alerts.
Smart Purifier – Provides service reminders for convenient maintenance.
Supreme Aesthetics – Compact and stylish wall-mounted design.
Long Cartridge Life – Reduces the frequency of cartridge replacement.
